statement: theorem quadratic_fixed_lift {A J : Type} (g : Abelian A) (h : Abelian J) (phi : Hom g h) (FA : Hom g g) (FJ : Hom h h) (commutes : ∀ a, phi.toFun (FA.toFun a) = FJ.toFun (phi.toFun a)) (surjective : ∀ x, ∃ a, phi.toFun a = x) (kernel_two : ∀ c, phi.toFun c = h.zero → g.add c c = g.zero) (kernel_cube : ∀ c, phi.toFun c = h.zero → FA.toFun (FA.toFun (FA.toFun c)) = c) (x : J) (fixed : FJ.toFun x = x) : ∃ b, phi.toFun b = x ∧ FA.toFun (FA.toFun b) = b
